translations.web: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
translations.bsb: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
translations.kjv: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
translations.asv: that thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
